summary: Advances per-entry animation timers by a per-frame delta. Each entry whose accumulator is still below its duration has the timer incremented and a completion flag bit cleared; each entry that has reached or passed its duration keeps the timer, sets the completion flag bit, and calls InterruptDispatch with the timer value. Iterates a node list from an animation block anchored at this+0x110.

operations.description: Load the animation block pointer from this+0x110 (decompiler this[68]) as the walk anchor.

Walk the animation-node linked list: start at the block pointer +0x90 bytes, follow each node's next link at +0xC0 bytes until null. this+0x134 names the container and the packet's *(this+0x134)+0x15C field the list/iteration data.
Per-node state check: only process the node when its state/control field (attributed to *(this+0x134)+0x168) has bit 0x400 set.
Entry-loop gate: only iterate when the entry count field (attributed to *(this+0x134)+0x164) is greater than 0 (packet guard:0).
Iterate the node's entry array starting at the entries pointer +0x40 bytes, advancing by a fixed 37-dword stride per entry.
Per-entry gate: only advance the timer when the entry threshold counter (attributed to *(this+0x134)+0x1A8) is greater than 1 (packet guard:1).
Compare the entry's current timer (+28 bytes) against its duration (+24 bytes); a timer below duration keeps the animation running.

Timer below duration: add the caller delta to the accumulator (attributed to *(this+0x134)+0x1B0) and clear the completion flag bit 2 (value 4) in the entry flag word (attributed to *(this+0x134)+0x1C4).
Timer reached or passed duration: keep the timer value, set the completion flag bit 2 (value 4) in the entry flag word, and dispatch the interrupt callback with the current timer value.
Call InterruptDispatch with the entry timer value when an entry completes.
Return the last computed result register value; it is not an explicit status, so the return value carries no confirmed semantic.
